name: Page Header
description: A responsive page title, supporting text, and action area.
usage:
<PageHeader
  title="Workspace settings"
  subtitle="Manage security and notifications"
  actions={<Button>Save changes</Button>}
/>

anatomy.description: Page heading rendered as h1 by default; adjust with titleAs to fit the page outline.
Supporting text rendered under the title.
Trailing action area that wraps below the title on narrow screens.

dos: Keep one primary action in the actions slot; demote the rest.
Set titleAs so the heading level fits the page outline.
Pair with Breadcrumb above when the page sits deep in a hierarchy.
donts: Don't repeat the global Top Bar actions here; keep them page-level.
Don't stack multiple page headers on one route.

examples.title: Settings header
examples.description: Actions wrap below the title on narrow screens automatically.

examples.title: Responsive actions
examples.description: Let actions wrap beneath the title on narrow screens.

guidance.useWhen: A route needs a consistent title, context, and primary actions.
guidance.avoidWhen: The content is a small inline section without route-level actions.
guidance.behavior: Actions remain aligned with the title and wrap below it when needed.
guidance.responsive: Let actions wrap naturally below the heading at narrow widths.

notes: The title renders as an h1 by default; set titleAs to fit the page outline and keep one h1 per page.
Actions are regular buttons and links with standard focus order.
